tests.procedure: Under strong white light check each received sample container separately in a clean transparent watch glass or glass dish for foreign particles, colour and conformity with the visual specification.

details.reference: Supplier Certificate for Opadry Brown; in-house specification

tests.source: Opadry Brown__STM Opadry Brown new without micro.txt:28

tests.procedure: Dispersion: disperse 1 g of sample into 20 mL water; the sample should diffuse into water and make a uniform matrix.

details.reference: Analytical Method Verification Report For Dispersion in Opadry Brown

tests.source: Opadry Brown__STM Opadry Brown new without micro.txt:29

tests.procedure: Identification: make a 10-12% slurry of the powder in water, pour it on a glass tile, dry at 70 °C; a film layer must form.

details.reference: Analytical Method Verification Report For Identification in Opadry Brown

tests.source: Opadry Brown__STM Opadry Brown new without micro.txt:30

tests.procedure: Total ash: weigh an empty crucible previously ignited at 800 °C (W1); weigh about 1.0 g sample (W2); ignite in muffle at 800 ± 50 °C for 2 h; cool in desiccator; weigh the crucible with residue (W4). W3 = W4 - W1; total ash (weight) = W2 - W3; % total ash = total ash / W2 x 100.

details.reference: Analytical Method Verification Report For Ash Content in Opadry Brown
